profile.headline: Software Engineer at ChannelAdvisor
profile.summary:
Since 2020, I have been working at ChannelAdvisor, focusing on the First Party/Dropship area, performing eCommerce integrations using API and protocols such as  REST, AS2, FTP and similars, for clients and marketplaces such as Amazon, SamsClub, Pepsi, BigCommerce and others, using a wide range of cloud-based tools, agile and .NET technologies.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on Helix Technologies, developing and deploying modular software solutions for IoT and Industriy 4.0, for customers such as Roca, Sonae Arauco or GHI. Main technologies used are .NET C# and SQL Server.

From 2017 to 2019 I was working on Altran on Mission Planners for Airbus A330 MRTT, developing under .NET C# WPF/MVVM and especializing on planning engine, numerical calculations and refuelling patterns. 

Previously, I spent 7 years working on Aertec Solutions, focused on developing software support applications for Airbus programs, such as Operative Planning, Flight Line and Delivery Centre for A330MRTT and A400M.  

Also, on these years I have been performed aeronautical consultancy projects such as:
 - Extend the scope of Aertec Solutions quality system under EN9100 and Airbus Normatives.
 - Operational Consultancy and simulations under Delmmia Quest, for R&D Calipso Neo and Airbus and Alestis factories.
 - Software and Hardware developing for R&D CleanSky projects and avionics test benches

Specialties: Software development, Operational Consultancy, Quality Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Software developing on .Net for Airbus Defense & Space.

Development of modules for mission planning platform for A330 MRTT (E-MPS), mainly Performance, numerical calculations and refuelling patterns.
 · Technologies: C# (.Net v4.6) , WPF y SQL. MVVM, Prism 6.0 based Arquitecture.

Software development of Avionics controller prototypes developed under C# for communications protocol ARINC 439, ARINC 739, ARINC 750, MIL STD 1553
 · Technologies: .NET C#, WPF, interfacing with ARINC DAQ Ballard cards.
positions.insights: Skills: WPF · ARINC · Programación · Aviónica · Engineering · LINQ

positions.title: Industrial Engineer
positions.description:
Software design and development of  Industrial Organization, Quality & Logistics Support Tools, for Airbus D&S and Airbus Operations. Development of desktop, web and mobile applications under .NET Framework

Operational Consultancy, PLM and Planning (Airbus D&S, Airbus Operations. Madrid/Seville). Development of Delmia Quest and Assembly simulations for R&D projects Airbus Hafei plant, Calipso Neo R&D projects.

Main goals achieved are:
 - Providing value-added IT solutions for department services under airbus premises, such as airbus A400M Operational Planning , FTC, Delivery Centre & A330 MRTT
 - Acquiring deep knowlege of Airbus information management systems and needs

positions.title: Customer management - Quality support in A400M Delivery Center
positions.description:
Quality Support in A400M delivery Center, developing the following tasks:
- Coordination of customer aircraft inspections
- follow-up and drumbeating of Request for Reworks with Industrial Partners and customers.
- Quality inspection process standardisation during Aircraft delivery phase
- QLB (Quality Log Book) management.
- Development of IT applications for internal management of incidences, report generation and continuous improvement implementation.

Main goals achieved are:
 - Setting up web and mobile IT applications keys to delivery Centre process: inspection support tool, interface with industrial partners, report and KPI generation, communication with Airbus information systems
- Successful delivery of the 8 first A400M aircrafts, dealing with OCCAR customers during the customer inspection.

positions.description: Quality Management System ISO 9000 & EN 9100, non-conformity management, aeronautical material and processes, NADCAP audits, Lean Manufacturing.

positions.description: Estudiante de Ingeniería Industrial, especialidad Automática y Robótica Industrial.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Calidad en la Industria Aeronautica y Espacial (QIAS)

projects.title: Desarollo de prototipos de controladores de aviónica
projects.description:
Desarrollo de prototipos para controlar diversos dispositivos de aviónica tales como MCDU, RMS, VDR, de acuerdo con los protocolos ARINC 429, ARINC 739, ARINC 750, MIL STD 1553.

Implementación desarrollada bajo .NET C# 4.6 WPF, y empleando librerías de comunicación con tarjetas de adquisición de datos Ballard.

projects.title: A330 MRTT Enhanced Mission Planner System
projects.description:
Desarrollo de módulos de planificación de misiones, enfocado cálculo de rendimiento numérico en las rutas y patrones de repostaje.

Tecnologías: .NET, C# 4.6, WPF Prism 6.0, WPF, MVVM, PostSharp
